doc.title: Alicia Olatuja interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 9, 2018

title: Welcome and thanks to her team
summary: Monk Rowe welcomes her; she credits her team and band, including Miles Weinstein.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Alicia Olatuja for us, for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Welcome to Hamilton.
And congratulations on your career so far.

Oh, thank you. I have a great team of people and one of the members of my team is right there, Miles Weinstein, and I have a great band and we all work together. We’re like a team and we just push each other forward.
